commit.message:
Live voice speaks as the agent, and offers Gemini Live (#239)

* Live voice speaks as the agent, and offers Gemini Live

The voice brief now comes from the agent's own name and SOUL.md, and every
rule is in the first person, so the voice model is the agent on the call
instead of a front end that talks about "your agent".

Gemini Live joins GPT-Live: `offer` with `provider: "gemini"` makes a
single-use token that locks the model, voice, brief and tools, and the app
connects to Gemini with it. The agent's Gemini key stays on the host.

Closes #238
